# Sessions

The plugin `claudetto-sessions` reads the Claude Code setup and the past transcripts.
It adds one skill, `sessions`, with two `bun` scripts, `audit` and `replay`.
Read this page to learn what each script prints and when to use it.

The plugin works without the core plugin.
Its one slice is `sessions`.

## What It Does for You

Claude Code has views for the live session: `/context`, `/usage`, `/insights`, `/hooks`, `/permissions`, `/plugin`, `/skills`, `/memory`, and `/status`.
Use the skill only for what those views do not give.
Both scripts change no file and make no model call.
The plugin has no hook, no command, and no `userConfig`.

The skill sets `disable-model-invocation: true`, so you start it.
It grants `bun ${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}/audit.ts *` and `bun ${CLAUDE_SKILL_DIR}/replay.ts *`.
Claude copies each figure of the output and does not compute, round, or convert it.

## How to Install It

1. Have Bun on `PATH`.
2. Install the plugin with `/plugin install claudetto-sessions@claudetto`.

## The `audit` Script

```text
bun audit.ts [--home DIR] [--project DIR] [--managed FILE]
```

The script prints JSON.
Each option is optional.

| Option | Default |
| --- | --- |
| `--home` | `~/.claude` |
| `--project` | The current folder |
| `--managed` | `/Library/Application Support/ClaudeCode/managed-settings.json` on macOS, else `/etc/claude-code/managed-settings.json` |

The output has these keys:

| Key | Content |
| --- | --- |
| `settings` | The keys that each layer sets: `managed`, `user`, `project`, and `local` |
| `plugins` | The `enabledPlugins` of the layers |
| `hooks` | The count of hook groups for each event, for each layer |
| `bytes` | The size of the texts that load at session start |

`bytes` has these parts:

- `memory`: the `CLAUDE.md` files of the home folder and the project, and `CLAUDE.local.md`.
- `rules`: each file in `rules/` with no `paths:` frontmatter.
- `onMatch`: each rule with `paths:`, which loads only when Claude works on a matching file.
- `skills` and `agents`: the size of the listing line of each file (`name` and `description`).

`audit` skips the skills and agents that plugins ship, the `CLAUDE.md` files of parent folders, and the `@` imports.

## The `replay` Script

```text
bun replay.ts HOOK_MODULE [PROJECTS_DIR]
```

The script runs a hook module on each tool call in the transcripts under `PROJECTS_DIR`.
The default folder is `~/.claude/projects`.
It counts the denies.

The module exports `check(event, prior)`, sync or async.

- `event` has the shape of a `PreToolUse` input: `hook_event_name`, `tool_name`, `tool_input`, `tool_use_id`, `cwd`, `session_id`, and `transcript_path`.
- `prior` is the list of the transcript rows before the call, in the same file.

A result counts as a deny when it has `deny`, `decision: "block"`, or `permissionDecision: "deny"`.
The script reads these keys also under `hookSpecificOutput`.

The output is JSON with `calls`, `denies`, and `shown`.
Each item of `shown` has the file, the tool, and the reason.
List the denies so that the user can judge which ones are false.

The plugin `claudetto-sessions` shows what Claude Code loads at session start and what a hook would have denied.
It adds one skill, `sessions`, with two `bun` scripts, `audit` and `replay`.
Both scripts only read.
